svg.title: Deterministic SDC analysis pipeline
svg.desc: Four-stage left-to-right pipeline: SDC input document, deterministic analysis engine, seven-dimension readiness verdict, CI quality gate with exit codes.

g.text: sdc in → rule evaluation → seven-dimension verdict → ci gate
same sdc + same corners = same verdict, every run
ONE VERDICT PER DIMENSION, NO OVERALL AVERAGE

svg.text: pure function of its inputs · no sampling · no model inference · identical output on every run
